runs.quote: reactive and easily subject to corrosion during separation,

runs.text: In the EG-based process the aluminum foil was fully recovered with shiny surfaces, and the document concludes there was no corrosion:

runs.quote: process fully recovered the aluminum foils with shiny surfaces,

runs.text: . Corrosion was seen only in the water comparison, where lithium leached from the NMC cathode:

runs.quote: corrosion due to lithium leaching from the NMC cathode,

runs.text: The corrosion would contaminate the NMC particles by forming aluminum hydroxide precipitates on the cathode surfaces, as the document puts it:

runs.quote: aluminum would contaminate the NMC particles by forming Al

runs.text: The document does not describe any step that removes this corrosion product. The only removal step it describes is rinsing the delaminated cathode with alcohol to remove EG residues:

runs.quote: the delaminated cathode materials were rinsed with alcohol

rendered: The document does not say the EG process corroded the aluminium foil; it reports the opposite. Its general point is that aluminum foils are reactive, as the document states: reactive and easily subject to corrosion during separation,[1] In the EG-based process the aluminum foil was fully recovered with shiny surfaces, and the document concludes there was no corrosion: process fully recovered the aluminum foils with shiny surfaces,[2] suggesting that no corrosion occurred[3]. Corrosion was seen only in the water comparison, where lithium leached from the NMC cathode: corrosion due to lithium leaching from the NMC cathode,[4] making the water solution basic.[5] The corrosion would contaminate the NMC particles by forming aluminum hydroxide precipitates on the cathode surfaces, as the document puts it: aluminum would contaminate the NMC particles by forming Al[6] (OH)3 precipitates on the cathode surfaces.[7] The document does not describe any step that removes this corrosion product. The only removal step it describes is rinsing the delaminated cathode with alcohol to remove EG residues: the delaminated cathode materials were rinsed with alcohol[8] to remove the EG residues.[9]
